name: io.github.yybd/multi-mail-mcp
title: multi-mail
description: Several Gmail accounts: search, read, draft, send, labels and Google Calendar. Own OAuth client.

environmentVariables.name: MULTI_MAIL_DEFAULT
environmentVariables.description: Account used when a tool call names none (email or alias)

environmentVariables.name: MULTI_MAIL_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder holding credentials.json and account tokens (default ~/.multi-mail)

environmentVariables.name: MULTI_MAIL_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to off for drafts-only mode: no tool can send mail
